articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers travelling in both directions.
articles.content_html:
A lift at Derker tram stop is out of service as of 5:10pm on 11 August 2026. The disruption will continue until further notice.

Passengers travelling towards Manchester can access the Manchester-bound platform via a ramp from Cromford Street. Those travelling away from Manchester can use a ramp from Cromford Street and a track crossing to reach the Rochdale-bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester has apologised for any inconvenience caused by this disruption.

For more information, visit the Transport for Greater Manchester website.
